{{Otheruses|Ruby}}
The '''rubygrub cysts''' were a monocellular [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Loth]]. The [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Stroiketcy]] had organocrystalline structures in open [[Water/Legends|water]] that compared favorably with the cysts.
